svg.title: Dork: stationary animation and movement graphics
svg.desc: Actual game bytes; two-bit index colours for inspection, not the TED display palette.
svg.text: Dork: stationary animation and movement graphics
Actual game bytes; two-bit index colours for inspection, not the TED display palette.
Stationary: BALMAN at $265D; four 32-byte frames copied to glyphs 28-31
MANGLP sequence: 0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 3... | 16 x 16 screen dots (8 x 16 colour samples)
Horizontal movement: four 3 x 2 tile blocks, selected by XPIX
Vertical movement: four 2 x 3 tile blocks, selected by YPIX
Movement blocks include empty space: PRINT swaps six tile codes; it does not shift a hardware sprite.
